targets.query: from(bucket: "iot-data") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_measurements" and r._field == "temperature_c") |> group(columns: ["order_id"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: 2s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "temperature")

from(bucket: "iot-data") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_measurements" and r._field == "vibration_mm_s") |> group(columns: ["order_id"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: 2s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "vibration")

from(bucket: "iot-data") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_measurements" and r._field == "pressure_bar") |> group(columns: ["order_id"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: 2s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "pressure")

from(bucket: "iot-data") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_measurements" and r._field == "temperature_c") |> group(columns: ["order_id"]) |> aggregateWindow(every: 2s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> yield(name: "temperature_heatmap")
from(bucket: "iot-data") |> range(start: -15m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_measurements") |> group(columns: ["order_id"]) |> last() |> yield(name: "latest")

from(bucket: "iot-data") |> range(start: -30d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "order_results") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: string(v: r._value) })) |> group(columns: ["orderId"]) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with quality: float(v: r.quality) })) |> group() |> keep(columns: ["orderId","quality","remark","planned_delivery","delivery_remark"]) |> sort(columns: ["orderId"]) |> yield(name: "orders")
